description:
The Acropolis Museum in Athens is dedicated to the archaeology of the Acropolis and its slopes. Opened in 2009, it presents the history of this single site through its collections.

Archaic sculpture, offerings and the architectural decoration of the Parthenon are central themes. Excavated remains of an ancient Athenian neighbourhood beneath the building add a view of the surrounding city’s daily life.

description:

description:
